title: Hollywood Sign Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
By California law all passengers must be seated even babies. Tickets must purchased for each passenger.
This is a 45 min sightseeing ride + 15 min stop for pictures
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Experience an exclusive 1-hour Hollywood Sign tour like never before. 

Enjoy VIP access to get up close and capture stunning photos of the iconic Hollywood Sign. Immerse yourself in the beauty of the Hollywood Hills as you explore their scenic trails. Our knowledgeable local guides will share fascinating stories and historical insights about Hollywood, while driving by famous landmarks.

This unique experience combines breathtaking views, exclusive access, and interactive narratives, making it an unforgettable adventure.
